chunks: Ali ibn al-Hasan from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yusuf from Mu'adh ibn Thabit, Abu al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Jumay', from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) from his father (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Eat suhoor (pre-dawn meal), even if it is just a sip of water. Indeed, may the prayers of Allah be upon those who eat suhoor.'
ai.seo_question: What is the virtue of eating suhoor before fasting according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith underscores the spiritual and physical benefits of suhoor, highlighting its status as a distinct Sunnah that even a mere sip of water can fulfill. The concluding invocation of *salawat* specifically upon the *mutasahhirin* (those who eat suoor) elevates this daily act of worship, linking it to divine grace and prophetic tradition within Shia jurisprudence.
